# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to providing a welcoming and inspiring community for all people. Our community is based on mutual respect, tolerance, and encouragement.

We pledge that:
- We will be welcoming and open to all
- We will be inclusive and welcoming regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, sexual identity, and sexual orientation
- We will be respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences
- We will accept constructive criticism gracefully
- We will focus on what is best for the community
- We will show empathy towards other community members

## Expected Behavior

Community members are expected to:
- Be welcoming and kind to others
- Use inclusive language
- Be respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
- Give and receive constructive feedback gracefully
- Focus on what is best for the community
- Show empathy towards other community members
- Report any behavior that violates this Code of Conduct

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behaviors are considered harassment and are unacceptable within our community:
- Harassment, intimidation, or discrimination
- Trolling, insulting/derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission
- Violent threats or language directed against another person
- Sexist, racist, or otherwise discriminatory jokes and language
- Unwelcome sexual attention
- Advocating for or encouraging any of the above behaviors

## Consequences of Unacceptable Behavior

Unacceptable behavior will not be tolerated. Anyone asked to stop unacceptable behavior is expected to comply immediately. If a community member engages in unacceptable behavior, the maintainers may take any action they deem appropriate, up to and including a permanent ban from the community.

## Reporting Issues

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, or have any other concerns, please:

1. **Report via GitHub Issue:** Use the [Code of Conduct Report template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/code_of_conduct_report.yml) to submit a confidential report.

2. **Contact a maintainer:** Reach out directly via GitHub private message for urgent concerns.

All reports will be handled confidentially. Personal data is handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and will be deleted once the case is resolved.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.

## Community Guidelines

Beyond the Code of Conduct, we ask that all community members follow these guidelines:

### In Issues and Discussions
- Search for existing issues/discussions before opening a new one
- Provide clear, specific information
- Be patient and respectful with other contributors
- Stay on topic

### In Pull Requests
- Include a clear description of changes
- Reference related issues
- Be open to feedback and suggestions
- Respect the review process

### In Comments and Reviews
- Provide constructive feedback
- Focus on the code, not the person
- Acknowledge good work and improvements
- Help others learn

---

We're glad you're here. Let's build an amazing community together! 🌟
